descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Singapore or Sydney About the department In this role, you will be focused on maintaining the Cloudflare global network. You'll work closely with Cloudflare’s SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) team, Network Engineering team, Network Deployment Engineering team and with various vendors and partners (including hardware vendors, datacenter and network providers, and ISPs) to maintain and improve our global infrastructure. You will further be responsible for the development and implementation of consistent processes and visibility measurements for consistent and effective management of our infrastructure. This is a highly visible position that requires deep technical understanding of datacenter infrastructure, networking (physical), and basic experience with data analysis and project management. To be successful in this position, you should have excellent technical skills, communication skills, and be able to navigate a range of challenges and constraints (e.g. schedule adherence, time zones, and cultures). You will have the opportunity to (literally) build a faster, safer Internet for our millions of users and the billions of web surfers that visit their sites each month. Who you are You will thrive in a hypergrowth engineering environment and be self driven with a keen attention to detail. You will come with a deep technical understanding of Data Center colocation environments, network architecture and server technologies. You will be used to working through partners to support infrastructure delivery to a number of remote locations. You will have had experience managing operational environments, and used to developing new approaches to improve delivery efficiency or operational stability.  What you'll do Collaborating with internal teams (Infrastructure, Network Engineering and SRE). Create documentation and manage remote contractors to complete datacenter tasks, working with hardware manufacturers, datacenter and network providers, logistics partners and other service providers in support of our 330+ cities and 125+ countries Maintain Data Center environment operational availability Leverage AI tools to automate repetitive operational tasks, accelerate documentation, and speed up troubleshooting and root-cause analysis Creating and maintaining documentation, plans, SOP’s, MOP’s etc. Support and configure network infrastructure where required Providing feedback to internal teams to support internal tools and external vendor partnerships Required Experience Experience with Juniper, Cisco and DWDM network equipment Minimum of 4 years experience of Linux systems administration Experience managing and instructing remote contractors  Familiarity with work required to stand up infrastructure in remote colocation facilities  Experience running and improving operational processes, including automation tooling, in a rapidly changing environment Familiarity with day-to-day tasks and projects common to Data Center Operations (deployment, migration, decommissioning etc.) Comfortable handling basic program management responsibilities (prioritization, planning, scheduling, status reporting) such as JIRA Participate in a shared on-call rotation to maintain 24×7 operational availability of the global network. An overview of this role As a Demo Architect, you'll help GitLab teams and customers get hands-on with our platform faster and with less friction. You'll build and improve the tools, applications, and infrastructure that support field team demos, workshops, trials, and internal test environments across the field.  What makes this role unique is its mix of software engineering, infrastructure, and customer-facing collaboration. Advise on sales opportunities when specialized technical demo support or custom solutions are needed. Improve the presenter experience by reducing manual setup work and making demo workflows easier to use and repeat. Support internal teams that rely on demo or test infrastructure, helping keep those environments available and useful. Troubleshoot urgent demo/workshop environment issues under pressure and communicate status clearly to stakeholders. What you'll bring Experience building software, systems, or internal tools that support technical users or business teams. Ability to deliver production-grade software and automation with attention to reliability, maintainability, and documentation. Ability to work across application development and infrastructure, with comfort navigating provisioning, automation, and service workflows. Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools to shorten investigation time when something breaks. Comfort communicating and collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Marketing, UX, and Engineering. Understanding of how to design and iterate on solutions for usability and repeatability, not just technical correctness, with awareness that the end user may be a seller or Solutions Architect. Ability to operate independently in a remote, asynchronous environment, with willingness to travel periodically for team offsites and occasional in-person planning/whiteboarding sessions. Exposure to technical demos, workshops, trials, or enablement assets, and/or interest in learning the pre-sales context; transferable experience from software engineering, site reliability engineering, systems engineering, solutions architecture, or similar technical paths.   #LI-CM1 About the team On the Demo Architect team at GitLab, we support the field’s demo, workshop, and trial experiences by maintaining shared tooling and the infrastructure behind internal demo and test instances used across GitLab. An overview of this role As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be a trusted technical advisor to GitLab’s largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, helping them avoid operational disruption and get the most from GitLab. You’ll combine deep Linux systems expertise, GitLab and CI/CD knowledge, and a proactive support mindset to understand each customer’s environment, anticipate and prevent issues, and solve complex technical and business challenges. In a typical week, you might be prioritizing strategic blockers with customer stakeholders, partnering with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales to drive defect resolution and influence the roadmap, or diving into code, logs, and tools like strace to troubleshoot performance issues. Your impact in the first year will be measured by customer trust, reduced critical incidents, and clear, reusable support content that empowers customers and GitLab teams alike. What you’ll do Provide technical support to our largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, ensuring their GitLab environments remain stable and performant. Troubleshoot and resolve complex, critical, and sensitive support issues using tools like Zendesk, logs, and Linux utilities such as strace, through email and video conferencing. Build strong, proactive relationships with key customer stakeholders, helping them prioritize and address their most important technical blockers. Collaborate with Product , Development , Infrastructure , Customer Success , and Sales teams to drive bug fixes, influence feature development, and help shape product goals and roadmap. Act as a technical expert on GitLab and CI/CD implementations, advising customers on how incidents and service interruptions impact their workflows and how to mitigate them. Create and improve support content, including documentation and knowledge articles, to help customers and GitLab team members resolve issues more efficiently. Partner closely with Support Engineering team members through pairing sessions and stable counterpart relationships to share knowledge and solve problems together. Contribute to team growth by participating in hiring processes, including reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews. What you’ll bring Background managing complex, customer facing support cases end to end, from initial inquiry and triage through reproduction, escalation, and resolution. Advanced troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate ambiguous, multi-layered technical issues and identify root causes across applications, infrastructure, and integrations. Strong Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent), including performance analysis and low-level debugging tools. Practical experience with GitLab and continuous integration / continuous delivery (CI/CD), including how different deployment models and outages affect customers. Ability to write and maintain clear, reusable support content such as knowledge articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides. Proficiency with scripting languages (such as Ruby or Bash) and familiarity with model-view-controller (MVC) frameworks, preferably Ruby on Rails. Effective communication skills for explaining complex technical topics to audiences with varying technical backgrounds and for building rapport with customer stakeholders. Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless platforms, with openness to applying transferable skills from related domains. About the team The Support team is a fully distributed, global group across the AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions, focused on helping customers get the most from GitLab by troubleshooting complex issues and digging into code and logs to understand why something is not working as expected. As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be part of our broader Support Engineering organization, working closely with other Support Engineers through regular pairing sessions, 1:1s, coffee chats, and Slack conversations to stay connected while collaborating asynchronously across time zones. We balance autonomy with accountability, giving you flexibility to structure your shift in a way that fits your life while ensuring we can reliably address customer issues. Thanks to GitLab’s Transparency value, you can see what we are working on in our Support Team page. Additionally, you can see our company roadmap and meetings to see what we are working on at any time. descriptionAr: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. Role Purpose We are looking for a driven, transaction-focused real estate professional to own deal execution across the Central region. You will be part of a lean, high-velocity expansion team reporting directly to the Director of Real Estate, US. This is not a support role. You will run site selection, lead LOI negotiations, manage broker relationships, and drive leases to execution across a growing portfolio of healthcare retail clinics in your markets. Neko is opening clinics at pace: the US plan moves from a handful of sites today to a 2028 cohort in the dozens and a portfolio in the hundreds by 2030. Most in-house real estate roles at this scale sit inside large corporate structures where deals move slowly and decisions need layers of approval. Here, your deals matter immediately, your judgment is trusted, and the decisions you make in year one will shape the portfolio for the next decade. The team is small and growing quickly, built around regional Transaction Leads covering the West, East, and Central United States, supported by national specialists in market analysis, deal support, and lease administration. Many of these seats are still being filled, so you will help set the standard rather than inherit one. What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months • Pipeline management: identify, evaluate, and advance sites across Central markets including Texas, Chicago, the Midwest, Nashville, and Denver. Markets are TBD and could extend west or east depending on demand. • Transaction execution: lead deals from initial market entry through signed lease, managing brokers, landlords, and timelines, at a pace set by the opening plan for the Central region. • LOI negotiation: draft, negotiate, and revise LOIs; own the deal process end to end from first tour to final execution. • Deal approval memos: build and present LOI and Lease Approval Memos with clear economics, risks, and a recommendation that stands up to executive scrutiny. • Landlord relationships: build and maintain relationships with institutional and private landlords across the Central region. • Broker coordination: manage tenant rep broker relationships across multiple markets simultaneously; hold brokers accountable to pipeline and timeline standards. • Cross-functional coordination: work closely with Legal, Construction, Design, and Facilities to move deals from signed lease into buildout. • Platform adoption: use Neko’s GIS site selection platform and lease administration system as the system of record and contribute to their rollout as the function scales. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI's data center construction teams work with engineering, supply chain, safety, quality, commissioning and operations partners to deliver the infrastructure that supports our computing needs. Mechanical delivery brings together cooling equipment, plant, piping and controls interfaces so that systems are installed, tested and ready for commissioning. About the Role As a Mechanical Lead, you will lead mechanical field delivery for data center construction, including cooling infrastructure, mechanical yards, piping and data hall fit-out. You will oversee general contractors, specialist installers and service providers, combining practical mechanical expertise with hands-on field leadership. Your focus will be safe installation, contractor performance, coordinated interfaces and complete evidence for commissioning and operational handover. Key Responsibilities Manage mechanical contractors, equipment and piping installers, and general-contractor interfaces against approved scope, schedule and quality requirements. Oversee installation readiness and delivery of cooling plant, pumps, heat rejection equipment, air handling, piping and applicable liquid-cooling infrastructure. Coordinate equipment placement, pipe routing, supports, access and maintainability with structural, electrical, controls and hardware teams. Review contractor work plans, constructability, submittals, RFIs and change proposals; resolve field issues with the responsible engineering teams. Oversee pressure testing, flushing, cleaning and inspection records; verify completion, defect closure and commissioning readiness. Support commissioning specialists with mechanical startup and system tests, corrective work and complete as-built, operating and maintenance documentation. Set contractor priorities, review staffing and progress, identify constraints early and coordinate recovery actions with construction leadership. Maintain clear progress, risk and change reporting, with accountable handoffs between construction partners and OpenAI teams. Qualifications Substantial mechanical construction, installation, field engineering or startup experience in data center cooling or comparable critical facilities. Demonstrated leadership of mechanical contractors or crews, including coordination across organizations without relying on direct reporting authority. Practical knowledge of cooling, ventilation, hydronic and pumping systems, heat rejection, piping cleanliness and vendor startup requirements. Ability to review drawings, specifications, submittals, work methods and controls narratives for constructability and installation readiness. Experience coordinating inspection, pressure testing, flushing, cleaning, balancing prerequisites and controls checkout. Ability to interpret test results and deficiency records with commissioning specialists and coordinate corrective work, retesting and turnover evidence. Clear communication and sound judgment when coordinating power, controls, startup and testing dependencies or escalating safety and delivery risks. Relevant trade, apprenticeship, technical or degree-based preparation, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Skills Owner-side or specialist-contractor experience with high-density data center cooling, liquid cooling or phased cooling-system startup. Experience with integrated systems testing, factory or site acceptance activities, and digital commissioning or field-reporting tools. Relevant mechanical trade, controls, balancing or commissioning qualifications, or professional engineering credentials. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI's Industrial Compute organization delivers the infrastructure that powers frontier AI models. Within Infrastructure Delivery, we turn engineering concepts into safe, reliable, and operational AI campuses by working across design, construction, utilities, commissioning, operations, and external partners. The fire protection function establishes the life-safety and property-protection strategy for these campuses. The team connects code requirements and engineering standards to practical design, construction, testing, incident readiness, and long-term operations. About the Role We are seeking a Fire Protection Engineer to lead owner-side fire and life-safety engineering across large-scale data center programs. You will establish design criteria, review complex fire protection systems, coordinate with authorities and delivery partners, and ensure that fire and life-safety requirements remain clear from early design through construction, commissioning, and operational handover. This role requires strong technical judgment across detection, alarm, suppression, smoke control, water supply, emergency response, and code compliance. You will work closely with engineering, construction, safety, security, commissioning, and operations teams to resolve risks quickly without compromising life safety, reliability, or schedule. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain fire protection and life-safety design criteria, technical standards, and review requirements for self-build data center campuses. Review fire protection drawings, specifications, code analyses, fire and life-safety narratives, hydraulic calculations, equipment submittals, and sequences of operation across all project phases. Provide owner-side engineering direction for fire detection and alarm, automatic suppression, fire pumps and water storage, smoke control, emergency communication, and related life-safety systems. Integrate fire protection requirements with architectural, structural, electrical, mechanical, controls, security, hardware, and operational systems. Partner with code officials, authorities having jurisdiction, insurers, consultants, contractors, and equipment vendors to resolve code interpretations and approval risks. Support constructability reviews, RFIs, submittals, field inspections, deficiency resolution, and change management during active construction. Define commissioning, integrated-system testing, acceptance, turnover, and operational-readiness criteria for fire and life-safety systems. Assess fire and life-safety risks associated with high-density compute, battery and energy-storage systems, generators and fuel systems, utility infrastructure, cooling systems, hazardous materials, and construction activities. Support incident response, root-cause reviews, corrective actions, and lessons learned, translating operational findings into improved designs and standards. Maintain clear records of design decisions, code positions, approvals, testing results, open risks, and turnover requirements. Travel regularly to project sites to support design reviews, field execution, testing, commissioning, and operational readiness. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Fire Protection Engineering or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience delivering fire and life-safety systems. 8+ years of fire protection engineering experience supporting data centers, industrial facilities, advanced manufacturing, energy infrastructure, or other mission-critical environments. Strong knowledge of applicable building and fire codes and standards, including IBC, IFC, NFPA requirements, and local authority approval processes. Technical depth in fire alarm and detection, water-based suppression, special-hazard suppression, fire pumps and water supply, smoke control, egress, and integrated life-safety systems. Experience reviewing fire protection designs, specifications, hydraulic calculations, equipment submittals, testing procedures, and commissioning results. Demonstrated ability to work with authorities having jurisdiction, engineering consultants, contractors, insurers, vendors, and internal stakeholders. Experience resolving field issues and design changes while maintaining clear code compliance, safety, quality, schedule, and documentation. Strong written and verbal communication, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to create clarity when requirements or ownership are ambiguous. Professional Engineer licensure in Fire Protection Engineering, or the ability to obtain licensure in relevant jurisdictions. Preferred Skills Experience with hyperscale data centers, high-density compute environments, or global multi-site infrastructure programs. Experience with battery rooms, energy-storage systems, generator plants, fuel systems, high-voltage substations, or other campus utility infrastructure. Familiarity with performance-based design, fire and smoke modeling, quantitative risk assessment, or fire-hazard analysis. Experience leading integrated testing and coordinating fire alarm, suppression, controls, security, mechanical, and electrical interfaces. Experience developing reusable standards, design templates, commissioning requirements, and incident-prevention programs across multiple sites. descriptionAr: About the Team The Data Center Build and Delivery team develops the infrastructure that supports OpenAI’s research and products. We work with engineering, construction partners and Operations to deliver safe, reliable facilities at scale. As our portfolio grows, consistent health, safety and environmental practices and clear performance measures help teams identify risks early and deliver sites that are ready to operate. About the Role We are looking for an HSE and Portfolio Performance Lead to strengthen health, safety and environmental oversight and performance management across our data center construction portfolio. You will help sites meet applicable OSHA standards and other HSE requirements, from construction through commissioning and handoff to Operations. You will work across site teams, delivery partners and central functions to establish practical expectations, verify execution and turn portfolio data into action. This role combines hands-on HSE expertise with a portfolio view of contractor performance, risk and operational readiness. Key Responsibilities Develop a consistent portfolio HSE framework covering contractor expectations, risk assessments, field verification, training and escalation, aligned with OpenAI’s EHS standards and relevant specialists. Translate applicable OSHA construction and general-industry requirements into practical site expectations, verify implementation and clarify responsibilities as work transitions from construction to commissioning and Operations. Partner with site and discipline leaders to assess high-risk work, verify critical controls and escalate unsafe conditions, including electrical energization, hazardous energy, lifting, excavation and concurrent construction and operating activities. Establish portfolio performance measures and reporting for HSE outcomes, contractor performance, corrective-action closure and handoff readiness; align definitions with delivery and Operations teams and validate data quality. Lead cross-site performance reviews to identify recurring risks, compare execution against agreed expectations and drive improvement plans with accountable owners, milestones and follow-through. Plan risk-based site assurance and contractor reviews, support incident and near-miss investigations, verify corrective actions and embed lessons learned across the portfolio. Coordinate environmental compliance with site teams and specialists, including waste management, spill prevention, stormwater controls and relevant permit obligations. Define HSE readiness criteria for operational handoff with commissioning and Operations teams, including training, procedures, emergency preparedness, outstanding risks and transfer of required records. Provide clear portfolio updates and recommendations to leadership, surface decisions and resource needs early, and build consistent safety leadership across employees, developers, contractors and service providers. Qualifications Substantial experience leading HSE programs for major construction or complex industrial projects, including oversight across multiple sites or workstreams and responsibility for contractor performance. Working knowledge of applicable OSHA construction and general-industry standards, with experience translating requirements into site controls and verifying implementation across construction, commissioning and operating interfaces. Practical understanding of data center or complex industrial hazards, including electrical safety, hazardous-energy control and high-risk construction activities. Demonstrated ability to build assurance, performance reporting and corrective-action programs and use leading and lagging indicators to improve outcomes. Experience coordinating contractors, site leaders and functional specialists through commissioning and operational handoff, with clear accountability across organizational boundaries. Strong communication and judgment, with the ability to explain technical risk, influence leaders and field teams, and prioritize action in fast-changing environments. Preferred Skills Experience with owner-side HSE oversight across a data center or mission-critical infrastructure portfolio, including developer-led and self-build delivery models. Experience integrating environmental compliance, emergency preparedness and HSE management systems into construction and operational readiness programs. Relevant professional credentials, such as CSP, CIH or an equivalent safety or environmental qualification, or comparable practical expertise. descriptionAr: About the Role Lead OpenAI’s site network infrastructure delivery, coordinating the physical installation and readiness of network systems with the central network team and contracted installation providers. You will be OpenAI’s accountable on-site lead for physical network infrastructure construction and deployment, directing and overseeing the work of general contractors, specialist contractors and other service providers within your discipline. You will combine practical subject-matter depth with hands-on field leadership, managing contracted support to deliver safe, high-quality work to the integrated construction plan. Reporting and scope Report to the Site Construction Manager, who reports through the applicable project-management leadership. Maintain functional alignment with the Network Infrastructure leader and central network engineering team. Own day-to-day discipline execution and contractor performance within the assigned site scope and delegated authority. Coordinate priorities and interfaces through the Site Construction Manager; escalate material cost, schedule, design and acceptance decisions to the appropriate owners. This is a senior site delivery role, suited to an experienced superintendent, supervisor, manager or trade lead. Accountability is for an assigned discipline and site work packages. Site assignment, duration and any shared coverage follow project phase, workload and the staffing plan; effective on-site coverage is required during critical activities. Key Responsibilities Manage structured-cabling contractors, fiber installers, network installation partners and other service providers against the site delivery plan. Translate approved network designs into executable field packages and coordinate bills of materials, material availability and installation sequencing with the central network team. Oversee pathways, duct banks and building-entry interfaces, fiber and copper cabling, racks, patching, labeling and network-equipment installation as applicable. Direct fiber and cabling quality assurance, review test results and traceability, and drive correction of defective or incomplete installations. Coordinate power, cooling, space and physical access readiness with electrical, mechanical and CSLA leads and hardware deployment teams. Coordinate network provisioning, connectivity validation and handover with authorized network engineering and operations teams; maintain accurate installation and as-built records. Set clear contractor deliverables and work priorities; review staffing, progress and quality, identify constraints early, and drive recovery actions through the Site Construction Manager. Provide concise progress and risk reporting, evaluate field impacts of proposed changes, and maintain accountable handoffs between construction partners and OpenAI teams. Qualifications Typically 8–10 years of large-scale data center network deployment, structured cabling, physical-layer installation or infrastructure delivery, with demonstrated field and contractor leadership. Equivalent depth of practical delivery experience will be considered. Strong understanding of physical data center network topologies, network components, bills of materials, rack constraints and installation sequencing; translate approved designs into executable field plans. Deep practical knowledge of fiber and copper plant installation, trunks, panels, terminations, cleaning, labeling and cable administration, including routing diversity and pathway separation. Ability to oversee and assess port-to-port verification, continuity, optical power and optical time-domain reflectometer (OTDR) testing; troubleshoot field installation and mapping discrepancies and verify remediation. Experience defining contractor work packages and statements of work, evaluating delivery requirements, forecasting labor needs and tracking quality, throughput, cost drivers and schedule performance within delegated authority. Experience coordinating deployment prerequisites with engineering and construction teams and completing formal operations handover with as-builts, port maps, test evidence and clear ownership transfer. Comfort with ticket-based execution, change control, incident escalation and documentation workflows that make network installation repeatable and auditable. Demonstrated ability to lead contractors and service providers through changing site conditions, set clear deliverables and acceptance criteria, and resolve performance gaps across organizations without relying on direct reporting authority. Strong written and verbal communication: maintain accurate field records, action and decision logs, and explain technical risks, schedule impacts and recovery options to site leadership, engineers and delivery partners. Sound judgment when information is incomplete: identify assumptions, prerequisites and interfaces, determine what work can proceed within approved authority, and escalate unresolved risks before they affect safety, quality or delivery. Wat je gaat doen Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en coördinatie van werkzaamheden binnen verschillende installatieprojecten. Je zorgt dat jouw team weet wat er moet gebeuren en dat projecten veilig, efficiënt en volgens afspraak worden uitgevoerd. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren van monteurs en technici; Coördineren en verdelen van werkzaamheden binnen werktuigbouwkundige installatieprojecten; Bewaken van de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit, veiligheid en kosten; Afstemmen met projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders, opdrachtgevers en leveranciers; Zorgen dat materialen, informatie en middelen tijdig beschikbaar zijn; Meedenken over technische vraagstukken rondom klimaatinstallaties, verwarming en luchtbehandeling; Signaleren van verbeterkansen en bijdragen aan efficiëntere werkprocessen; Onderhouden van goede contacten met klanten en andere betrokken partijen. Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen de monteurs hun werk goed uitvoeren en worden projecten succesvol opgeleverd. Wat neem je mee? Je hebt een stevige technische basis binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek en vindt het leuk om collega's aan te sturen en verder te helpen. Je kunt goed organiseren, communiceert duidelijk en weet ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren. Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in het volgende: Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding richting installatietechniek, werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar; Enkele jaren werkervaring binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek, bijvoorbeeld als Eerste Monteur, Leidinggevend Monteur of Teamleider; Kennis van gebouwgebonden installaties, zoals verwarmingsinstallaties, klimaatinstallaties en luchtbehandeling; Leidinggevende kwaliteiten en het vermogen om collega's te motiveren; Organisatorisch inzicht en een goed gevoel voor planning en kwaliteit; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling; Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om technische en organisatorische uitdagingen op te lossen. Heb je ruime ervaring als Eerste Monteur of Leidinggevend Monteur en ben je toe aan een volgende stap? Ook dan komen we graag met je in contact! Waar ga je het doen? Campus Installatietechniek is een installatiebedrijf gevestigd in Barneveld. We werken aan uiteenlopende werktuigbouwkundige installaties binnen de utiliteit en gebouwgebonden installatietechniek.Bij Campus houden we van korte lijnen, duidelijke afspraken en een praktische aanpak. We zorgen voor een goede voorbereiding en ondersteunen elkaar waar nodig. Hierdoor kunnen onze monteurs zich richten op hun vak en kunnen projecten efficiënt worden uitgevoerd. Als Teamleider krijg je de ruimte om mee te denken, verbeteringen door te voeren en jouw eigen stempel te drukken op de dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Je werkt samen met betrokken collega's die elkaar kennen, helpen en samen zorgen voor tevreden klanten. Wij zijn een trots onderdeel van de snelgroeiende VDK Groep (185 bedrijven, 9.000 collega’s), maar opereren met een eigen identiteit en cultuur. Dit betekent dat je bij ons de voordelen van een grote organisatie ervaart – denk aan opleidingsmogelijkheden, een stabiele basis en top secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden – terwijl je tegelijkertijd de vrijheid, dynamiek en verantwoordelijkheid krijgt om je eigen stempel te drukken bij het lokale bedrijf. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world. This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning. About the Role OpenAI is seeking a Motion Designer to help tell the stories behind our research. You’ll translate complex ideas, emerging capabilities, and the work of our researchers into clear, engaging motion across films, launches, demos, and other communications. Working within the creative team, you’ll partner with Research, Brand, and production teams to shape work from early concepts through final delivery. You’ll help determine what a story needs visually, explore different approaches, and bring those ideas to life through thoughtful design and animation. This is a hands-on role for someone with strong motion craft, curiosity about unfamiliar subjects, and the ability to find a compelling visual approach when the brief is still taking shape. You’ll contribute to how OpenAI’s research is expressed in motion, developing original work and reusable approaches that help the team build on what it learns. In this role, you will: Develop motion concepts for research stories, working with creative partners and subject matter experts to understand the ideas and identify how best to communicate them. Design and produce high-quality 2D and 3D motion for research films, launches, demos, and supporting content. Apply and extend OpenAI’s visual and motion language, balancing consistency with the needs of each story. Take work from visual exploration, storyboards, and animatics through animation, compositing, and final delivery. Collaborate closely with designers, filmmakers, editors, producers, and researchers, bringing a motion perspective into the creative process early. Translate technical or abstract concepts into visual sequences that are accessible to a broad audience while preserving the meaning of the underlying work. Work with producers to scope projects, communicate dependencies, and maintain a high standard of craft as priorities and timelines evolve. Present work clearly, explain creative decisions, and incorporate feedback from creative and technical partners. Develop reusable assets, templates, and workflows where they improve quality and make recurring work easier to produce. You might thrive in this role if you have: 7+ years of experience in motion design across films, campaigns, launches, or other narrative work. A strong portfolio demonstrating design judgment, animation craft, and the ability to carry an idea from concept through finished execution. The ability to explore an open-ended brief, propose a clear creative direction, and refine it through collaboration. Proficiency in After Effects and experience with Cinema 4D or comparable 3D tools, alongside editing and compositing workflows. Comfort working in Figma and sharing work across design and production teams. A strong understanding of typography, composition, timing, rhythm, and visual storytelling. Experience making complex or unfamiliar subjects understandable through design and motion. Experience working with subject matter experts and incorporating technical feedback without losing clarity or creative quality. Curiosity about AI and research, and a willingness to learn enough about a subject to represent it thoughtfully. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. descriptionAr: Who are we? Our mission is to scale intelligence to serve humanity. We’re training and deploying frontier models for developers and enterprises who are building AI systems to power magical experiences like content generation, semantic search, RAG, and agents. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. We like to work hard and move fast to do what’s best for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are passionate about their craft. Each person is one of the best in the world at what they do. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives is a requirement for building great products. Join us on our mission and shape the future! Why this role? We are on a mission to build machines that understand the world and make them safely accessible to all. Data quality is foundational to this process. Machines (or Large Language Models to be exact) learn in similar ways to humans - by way of feedback. By labelling, ranking, auditing, and correcting text output, you will improve Large Language Model’s performance for iterations to come, thus having a lasting impact on Cohere’s tech. Cohere seeks dynamic and dedicated Data Annotators with exceptional Modern Standard German Writing, Translation, and Data Manipulation skill. Please Note: This is a part-time independent contractor position available within Canada . We seek candidates who are able to commit to 16 hours per week minimum at a 30 CAD/hour contract rate. This role is BYOD 💻 - Bring Your Own Device (laptop). Remote work within Canada. 12 months contract. Performance incentives included! As a Data Annotation Specialist, you will: Label and Rank: Accurately label and rank machine learning data with advanced proficiency in German, ensuring data integrity and quality. Audit and Correct: Scrutinize and rectify any inaccuracies in language data (may include text, image, JSON, TSV/CSV, Markdown), maintaining the highest standard of data accuracy. Reading and Text-Based Tasks: Efficiently complete reading and text-based assignments, with high attention to detail. Preference-Based Tasks: Evaluate and complete tasks, assessing which responses in German best conform to project guidelines. Recommend Optimizations: Identify and suggest opportunities for improving data quality and model performance in German language tasks. Provide Feedback: Collaborate and communicate effectively, providing feedback to cross-functional team members, particularly on German language-related matters. Detail-Oriented Execution: Maintain meticulous attention to detail while performing repetitive and precise tasks, particularly when working with language data. You may be a good fit if you have: Language Proficiency: Native or near-native proficiency in German; excellent command over English. Expert reading and writing skills - which you are ready to prove on our written test. Basic familiarity with JSON/TSV/CSV/Markdown data manipulation. Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy - you’re the type to proofread all of your emails! High tolerance for repetitive and monotonous work. Ability to follow complex instructions, navigate ambiguity and work independently. Superb sense of urgency and time management. Curiosity about technology and a knack for tackling problems in creative ways. A reliable laptop. The Candidate Journey: Initial Screening - Once you have submitted your application our Talent Team will review your resume and writing samples. Virtual Annotation Test - This assignment will test your written skill through various language-based tasks, such as a a writing sample, interacting with a chat bot, and more. Video Screen - If selected to move forward, you will have a short video call with a member of our Operations Team! Offer - Independent Contractor Agreement As an independent contractor, you maintain control over how you complete your work and may work with multiple clients simultaneously, although we ask you to declare if any of these are with a direct competitor of Cohere and maintain IP confidentiality of the Cohere project. Independent contractors are not eligible for health benefits or other benefits provided to employees. Compensation for services is provided to contractors by contractors invoicing for services provided pursuant to the terms of our agreement with the contractor. It is important to understand that as an independent contractor, continuous work is not guaranteed . The client-contractor relationship is fundamentally project-based, meaning engagements may be temporary, periodic, or intermittent based on our organizational needs and project availability . As an independent contractor, you should anticipate fluctuations in workflow and therefore compensation for services when Cohere does not require as many hours of services in a week. Prospective candidates, please be advised: this role involves working with human generated and model generated tasks that may involve exposure to not safe for work (NSFW) text content as part of data annotation tasks, including explicit, offensive, or other inappropriate material. If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply! We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment for all. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs.

GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. An overview of this role As a Professional Services Engineer at GitLab, you'll partner with public sector customers to help them successfully adopt and expand GitLab across their organization. You'll deliver services such as installation, migration, training, and advisory engagements, meeting customers where they are, from single-node Omnibus installations to larger reference architectures using infrastructure as code and configuration as code. In this role, you'll balance hands-on technical delivery with clear communication and project ownership, helping customers make practical choices that fit their goals, timelines, and environments. As you work with customers, you'll act as a feedback loop to GitLab's product and engineering teams by communicating insights that can improve GitLab features and delivery processes. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, working across multiple engagements, and succeeding in a remote, largely asynchronous environment. Plan and execute GitLab deployments across a range of architectures, from single-node Omnibus installations to large reference architectures using infrastructure as code and configuration as code practices. Oversee and perform migrations from multiple source systems to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab, helping customers reduce risk, maintain momentum during change, and complete cutovers with minimal disruption. Provide technical guidance across the GitLab feature stack, helping customers adopt best practices that fit their goals, constraints, and operating environment. Partner closely with project managers and engagement managers by providing feedback and updates that improve delivery consistency, keep work on schedule, and reduce delivery issues across engagements. Manage and deliver multiple customer projects at once, balancing customer outcomes with awareness of billable time and delivery priorities to meet utilization and delivery goals. Mentor and assist other Professional Services Engineers by communicating expertise in specific technical areas and contributing to stronger, more repeatable delivery patterns. Work closely with GitLab's product and engineering teams to remove blockers for customers and help improve GitLab features and delivery processes based on field insights, leading to faster issue resolution and more consistent delivery. What you'll bring Professional experience with one or more infrastructure as code or configuration as code tools, such as Terraform, Ansible, Packer, Puppet, or Chef. Experience with one or more infrastructure as code or configuration as code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Packer, Puppet, or Chef. Active Secrets or TS/SCI (or other)  clearance is required for this role due to the nature of the customers you’ll support. Occasional travel to SCIF sites as needed. Desirable locations - DC Metro, GA, TX, AL, CO or UT Due to government security requirements, you must be a United States Citizen (defined as any individual who is a citizen of the United States by law, birth, or naturalization) to be eligible for this position Ability to support public sector customers with TS/SCI clearance-related requirements for their environments and engagements. Ability to lead technical delivery end-to-end, including discovery, planning, documentation, and knowledge transfer. About the team The Professional Services Engineer is part of GitLab's Professional Services organization, helping customers adopt GitLab successfully through installation, migration, training, and advisory engagements. The team works closely with Project Managers and customer stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes and help organizations expand how they use GitLab. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Austin, TX (US), Washington, DC (US), London (UK) About the team Cloudflare’s mission is to help build a better internet and the Threat Application Services (TAS) team lives at the core of that effort. The team builds the automated services and systems that transform Cloudflare’s massive network telemetry into actionable intelligence. We empower customers with products to combat advanced threats, enabling them to query, investigate, and automatically mitigate attacks using Cloudflare’s unique visibility into global threat actor activity. At a high level, the Threat Application Services team is the engineering engine within Cloudforce One. We are responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of threat intelligence data, from ingestion and enrichment to exposing high-fidelity indicators through the Threat Events platform and high-performance APIs. Our work ensures that threat intelligence is not just a report, but a scalable, real-time defensive layer across the Cloudflare stack. About the Role This role is for the Senior Engineering Manager of the Threat Application Services team within Cloudforce One’s Engineering organization. You will lead a team of high-performing engineers dedicated to building and scaling the Cloudforce One Threat Events platform, our external Threat Intel APIs, and the backend systems that integrate Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) directly into products like WAF and Gateway for automated mitigation. You will also lead hiring efforts to expand our engineering capabilities as we build the next generation of agentic threat intelligence tools. What you'll do You will be responsible for the architectural direction and operational excellence of the services owned by your team, ensuring our intelligence platforms meet the latency and reliability requirements of Enterprise security operations. You will also drive the professional development of your direct reports and collaborate with product managers and security researchers to turn complex threat data into intuitive, automated customer experiences. You thrive in a fast-paced environment where software engineering meets security research. You have experience delivering scalable distributed systems, managing complex data pipelines, and leading teams through the transition from "getting things done" to building world-class, reliable products. This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed. Desirable skills and experience Experience with AI-assisted development and agentic AI workflows. Prior experience building high-performance APIs or platforms for threat intelligence, security operations, or large-scale data analytics. 8+ years of Software Development experience, with a focus on Go, JavaScript, or distributed systems. Led high-performing engineering teams for over 8 years, responsible for architectural direction and operational excellence of large-scale distributed security platforms (e.g., Threat Intel APIs, automated mitigation systems). Proven ability to manage technical debt, drive professional development through strong mentorship, and excel at planning and execution to deliver predictable, world-class products in a high-growth environment. Proven experience leading engineering teams and managing technical debt in a high-growth environment. Understanding of the Cyber Kill Chain and how to automate the ingestion and distribution of IOCs (IPs, domains, hashes, JA3/4 fingerprints). Experience with edge computing (e.g., Workers), SQL-at-the-edge (D1/SQLite), and building systems that scale to handle trillions of signals. Excel at planning and execution to deliver predictable, reliable features for security teams. Strong mentorship and coaching skills to support the career growth of engineers in a specialized security engineering domain. Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Cloudflare's network is one of the largest in the world and spans over 330 cities in more than 125 countries. What's more, Cloudflare operates within 50 milliseconds of 95% of the Internet-connected population globally (for context, the blink of an eye is 300-400 milliseconds!). We are passionate about making the Internet more secure, reliable, and faster for everyone. Cloudflare’s Engineering teams build and run the software that handles the massive amount of traffic that flows through our network. We also have teams that build the UI and control plane for our software, using modern patterns and libraries in a microservices-based architecture. Technologies include: Typescript/Javascript, Go, Rust, C/C++ and Python. The ideal intern is passionate about making the Internet a better place. You will work alongside experienced engineers. You will push code this internship that touches hundreds of millions of web surfers. We like to get things done, so we are looking for interns who are curious, proactive, and able to complete projects. This is a great opportunity for engineers who want to learn to develop at Internet scale. You can check out our internship blogs to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns. Responsibilities Ship and deliver projects over 12-14 weeks with autonomy and support. Work cross-functionally with various teams. Work closely with a mentor to guide you through the internship and help with career goals. Build your network across the company through our various in and out of office socials, networking programs, Employee Resource Group (ERG) programs, and Activity Groups. Present your project to the entire company at the end of the internship. Connect and learn from our executives and leadership team including our co-founders. Learn and develop skills through our professional development workshops. Write for our Cloudflare blog and be featured on Cloudflare.tv sessions.  Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience Currently pursuing a degree or program in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or relevant field to the role. Demonstrated critical thinking skills and drive to learn and adapt new technologies. Curiosity, empathy and ability to get things done. Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship. In office 3-5 days a week in London, UK. Bonus Points Demonstrated passion for software development, such as personal projects, open-source contributions, or experience with our developer platform using  Cloudflare for Students. Please note We will be hiring interns on a rolling basis until all roles are filled. We are not considering remote or part-time for either terms. This is a full-time (40hr/week internship) with in-person expectations; standard business hours are typically 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM. You should not be enrolled in classes, which would conflict with full-time commitment. What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. descriptionAr: About the Team OpenAI’s Tax and Trade team sits at the center of OpenAI’s global growth, shaping how cutting-edge AI products, partnerships, and infrastructure scale across borders while navigating complex tax, trade, and regulatory regimes. We operate as strategic operators, not just compliance experts, embedding early in product, finance, policy, and infrastructure decisions to manage risk, unlock incentives, and enable OpenAI to grow responsibly and competitively worldwide. About the Role We’re hiring a Tax Director to advise on OpenAI’s global tax strategy and support the company’s continued international expansion. This role will partner closely with Legal, Finance, Corporate Development, and commercial teams on cross-border tax planning, operating model design, market entry, strategic partnerships, product launches, intercompany arrangements, and complex commercial transactions. You will bring deep international tax expertise and practical business judgment to help OpenAI move quickly while managing risk across a rapidly evolving global footprint. The role requires someone who can translate complex tax rules into clear recommendations, build scalable frameworks, and operate as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across the company. You’ll be responsible for: Support tax aspects of strategic transactions, including acquisitions, joint ventures, reorganizations, divestitures, and post-close integration, in partnership with Corporate Development, Legal, and Finance. Advise on international tax planning and global operating model design, including legal entity footprint, intercompany arrangements, IP ownership and use, customer contracting models, and cross-border service flows. Serve as a core tax business partner for global expansion initiatives, including new market entry, changes in operating footprint, and regional business scaling. Advise Product, Legal, Finance, and commercial teams on tax considerations for go-to-market motions, strategic partnerships, customer contracting, and new revenue models. Evaluate permanent establishment, withholding tax, treaty, source and character, transfer pricing, and other international tax considerations arising from global business activity. Monitor US and international tax law and policy developments, including Pillar Two and other global tax reform initiatives, and assess implications for OpenAI’s business planning and operating model. Advise on tax aspects of financing and treasury initiatives, including intercompany funding, capital structure planning, and third-party financings. Manage external advisors and coordinate internal stakeholders to deliver timely, practical, and high-quality tax advice across business initiatives. Build scalable frameworks, playbooks, and processes that enable consistent, repeatable tax advisory for a fast-growing global business. Communicate complex tax issues clearly to non-tax stakeholders, including senior leadership, and help drive decisions that balance tax efficiency, risk management, operational feasibility, and business priorities. We’re looking for someone with: A J.D. and strong academic credentials; LL.M. in Taxation a plus. 12+ years of progressive international tax experience, ideally with a mix of law firm and in-house experience at a high-growth multinational business. Strong foundation in complex domestic and cross-border M&A, joint ventures, reorganizations, and post-acquisition integrations. Extensive experience advising on cross-border commercial arrangements, market entry, strategic partnerships, and international expansion. Deep technical expertise in US international tax, including GILTI, FDII, BEAT, foreign tax credits, withholding tax, tax treaties, source and character of income, Subpart F, and permanent establishment principles. Strong understanding of transfer pricing principles, intercompany arrangements, IP planning, and global operating model design. Experience with Pillar Two and global tax policy developments, and ability to translate legislative change into practical business advice. Proven ability to distill complex tax concepts into clear, actionable recommendations for non-tax stakeholders and executive leadership. Exceptional judgment, presence, and communication skills; comfortable operating at senior levels of the organization. Track record of building trust and credibility across Legal, Finance, Product, Infrastructure, Corporate Development, and commercial teams. Workplace & Location This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We also pride ourselves in dogfooding our own products and services so you will be extensively working with Cloudflare’s developer platform as well. We are looking for great engineers regardless of experience with any of these specific technologies. Design, build, run, and scale distributed tools and services that support both cyber threat disruption and platform abuse efforts. Collaborate closely with Threat Intelligence, Trust & Safety, Legal, and Product teams to understand goals and translate complex technical requirements into elegant, scalable solutions. descriptionAr: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role The Pipeline Authoring group develops tools for creating and managing your pipelines. We balance maintaining core functionality of the product with developing newer areas. Our key areas of focus are CI/CD components and the CI/CD Catalog , which allows users to discover, reuse, and contribute CI/CD components to make software development more efficient and productive. As a Backend Engineer, you will work on maturing our Catalog and Component functionality and reliability, improve and maintain performance, scalability and security of Pipeline Creation, and always consider usability and user experience in these key areas of the product. Your contributions and collaboration with your fellow team members will ensure that GitLab CI/CD remains a best in class solution. Some of the things we have recently been working on include: Inputs for Pipelines Inputs for Jobs Inputs Enhancements CI/CD Catalog - UX improvements Learn more on the Pipeline Authoring direction pages: Pipeline Composition   Component Catalog   About the team The Pipeline Authoring team is made up of experienced Engineers, some having worked in this area for many years and some having joined more recently. The team shares a passion for finding solutions to complex challenges that scale and are maintainable. Located across five countries and several time zones, async communication is key to our success. The team lives by GitLab’s core values and is always eager to improve. Many things in GitLab begin with a pipeline, so our team regularly interacts with other GitLab teams, community contributors and customers as we strive to create the best possible Pipeline Authoring experience. Learn more on the Pipeline Authoring group handbook page and Pipeline Authoring Unfiltered playlist . Inspect work with quality teams, track nonconformances and punch lists, and verify contractor closeout, as-built records and turnover readiness. At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Lead the engineering behind usage metering, pricing definition engines, outcome verification, and revenue attribution models tailored for agentic workflows. Build capabilities that give businesses granular visibility and control over their agent-generated revenue streams. Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes. Bridge mainstream and decentralized tech, interfacing with blockchain teams while keeping execution focused on mainstream, high-throughput web and fiat commerce rails. Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow. Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, cryptographic security, and long-term reliability. descriptionAr: About the Team The Physical Engineering team sits within OpenAI’s Enterprise Verticals organization. We’re exploring how frontier AI can help people design, simulate, and build better physical products—shortening development cycles, improving product performance, and expanding what engineering teams can accomplish. Our initial focus is on mechanical and electrical engineering. We’re building experiences within ChatGPT and integrations with engineering software to help engineers move from early concepts through design, simulation, and preparation for production. We operate as a small founding team within OpenAI, working directly with customers and closely with research, design, and forward deployed engineers. We learn by building, putting products in users’ hands, and using their feedback to guide our next steps. About the Role As a Founding Full Stack Software Engineer, you’ll help define and build the product and technical foundations of this new vertical. You’ll work across frontend experiences, backend services, and integrations to bring AI into complex engineering workflows. You’ll combine strong software engineering fundamentals with product judgment and an eye for intuitive user experiences. Working directly with engineers and design partners, you’ll identify valuable problems, prototype solutions, and develop them into reliable products. We’re particularly interested in engineers who have built CAD, CAE, simulation, or other engineering design software. You should be comfortable owning work independently, making decisions with incomplete information, and moving between product details and system architecture. This is an opportunity to shape a new product area from its earliest stages, with significant influence over what we build, how it works, and the team we become. In this role, you will: Build and ship full-stack AI products that help mechanical and electrical engineers work through design and simulation tasks. Own projects from customer discovery and prototyping through production deployment and iteration. Create intuitive interfaces that help users understand, inspect, and refine complex engineering outputs. Develop backend services, APIs, plugins, and integrations that connect OpenAI models with engineering software. Work directly with customers to understand engineering constraints, identify valuable applications, and translate specific needs into broadly useful products. Partner with research, design, platform, and forward deployed engineering teams to bring emerging AI capabilities into practical workflows. Evaluate quality and reliability, using customer feedback and product evidence to understand whether we’re improving how engineers work. Help establish the technical foundations and engineering practices of a growing team. You might thrive in this role if you: Have independently built and shipped substantial software products, with ownership across frontend and backend systems. Bring strong product instincts and UI judgment, especially for tools that make complex work easier to understand and perform. Enjoy working directly with users and translating their needs into thoughtful product and technical decisions. Can turn an ambiguous opportunity into a clear starting point and a working product. Move quickly, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and stay accountable for quality after launch. Learn unfamiliar tools and domains quickly and communicate clearly across disciplines. Are excited about applying frontier AI to the design and development of physical products. Particularly relevant experience Building CAD, CAE, simulation, electrical design, or related professional software. Developing interactive tools for visual, spatial, or technically complex workflows. Connecting engineering tools through APIs, plugins, or extensions. Building AI-powered applications and evaluating their usefulness and reliability. Taking a product from concept to production as a founder or early engineer. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. descriptionAr: About the Team The Value Engineer team helps customers turn frontier AI into real business value. We accelerate adoption of OpenAI technology at scale and guide organizations from initial activation to measurable, organization-wide impact. We partner closely with Sales, Product, Solutions Architecture, and Security to deliver safe and responsible AI transformation. Our work shapes how customers generate and measure tangible outcomes from OpenAI products and creates a repeatable blueprint for successful enterprise launches and expansions. About the Role We are hiring a Value Engineer to help articulate and quantify the business value of OpenAI’s technology across Enterprise, Education, and Government customers. In this role, you will help customers and internal teams translate AI adoption into measurable financial and operational impact. As an early member of the Value Engineering team, you will help define how OpenAI measures and communicates the real-world impact of AI across its customers. You will partner closely with Sales, AI Success Engineers, AI Deployment Engineering, and Product teams to identify high-impact AI use cases and build financial and operational business cases. Your work will directly influence executive alignment, investment decisions, renewals, and long-term expansion. You will play a key role in helping build and shape the value engineering function from the ground up — developing repeatable frameworks, ROI models, value narratives, dashboards, and collateral that help internal teams and customers understand and measure the impact of AI adoption. Success in this role is measured by how clearly customers and internal teams can quantify the value of AI, how effectively business cases support adoption and expansion, and how scalable value frameworks become across the GTM organization. This role is based in San Francisco or New York City and we offer relocation benefits to new employees. In This Role, You Will Lead business value assessments for our largest deals, working closely with customers to identify key business drivers and quantify the value of OpenAI’s products to support investment decisions Build and maintain standardized ROI, TCO, and value modeling tools for internal and customer use. Lead structured value discovery to identify high-impact use cases and define measurable outcomes. Publish executive-ready business cases that quantify results and strengthen relationships with C-level stakeholders. Codify value frameworks, methodologies, and reusable assets that scale value-based selling across the global GTM organization.
